The '''Aquatic Scout Ship''' was a sleek, torpedo-shaped vessel used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==Characteristics==
It had a pair of stabilizer fins, carried no weapons, and was capable of traveling as far down as five kilometers below the surface. Each [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] was equipped with long-range sensors, manipulator arms, a tow cable, and storage areas to hold specimens and samples.

==History==
These vessels were used by [[Imperial Mining, Ltd.|IML]] to search for [[Ore/Legends|ore]] on [[Alluuvia]] and were usually crewed by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Technician/Legends|technicians]]. A [[MFB-4 Mobile Repulsor Base|Imperial Mobile Base]] on the planet carried army troopers, IML personnel and seven aquatic scout ships, although it had room for fifteen.
